sources.lead: Take the maximum of several exact abstraction distances as an admissible IDA* lower bound; the repository reports exact pattern databases over projected piece subsets.
sources.limitation: Puzzle-specific code and claims; no ACC support and external solver code must not be imported.

deduplication: No earlier scouting record mentions arXiv:2601.13465 or pattern-database abstraction.
harness_question: Can a harness-native exact finite projection lower bound reduce expansions without pruning a known valid route?

bounded_falsifiable_experiment.design: On one already witnessed selected row, build exact distances in one small harness-native projected state space using the pinned move table; use max(projected distance, existing bound) only as an ordering/lower-bound control.
bounded_falsifiable_experiment.equal_budget_control: Same selected row, seed, depth, wall, memory and 600000-record cap with the present ordering.
bounded_falsifiable_experiment.pass: Official replay remains exact, every known route survives, and admitted records to the same reached depth decrease by at least 20 percent.
bounded_falsifiable_experiment.fail: Any false pruning, shallower completed depth, or less than 20 percent record reduction.
bounded_falsifiable_experiment.authorization: Proposal only; do not run until registered as a distinct harness method.
